create_memory_mapped_dataset: create a MemoryMappedDataset from a file path to efficiently read large text files using memory mapping
initialize_memory_map: initialize a memory-mapped file with optional header skipping and line count limits using _initialize
create_corpus_dataset: create a CorpusDataset from numpy arrays to load tokenized input IDs with block indexing and attention masks
get_corpus_item: get a padded sequence item with input_ids, attention_mask, and is_valid from a CorpusDataset by index
process_dataset_line: process a raw line from a MemoryMappedDataset or CorpusDataset by overriding the process_line method
